# Generated by scripts/vendor_mbedtls.py -- TPy build shim.
# Builds a single static lib from the vendored mbedTLS sources,
# matching the direct-compile path. Not upstream's CMake.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(mbedtls_bundled C)
file(GLOB MBEDTLS_SOURCES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/library/*.c")
add_library(mbedtls STATIC ${MBEDTLS_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(mbedtls
    PUBLIC  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include"
    PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/library")
